answer: Trace funding lineage: every new agent key must receive its first gas from a wallet, and the ledger follows that inlet back three hops. Keys whose seed funds share an upstream source split one reward share, so a farm paid from a single onyx treasury earns like one agent. To avoid the merge, an attacker must fund each identity from an independent, pre-aged wallet acquired separately, costing real coins and months of history per clone; hollow keys with fresh one-hop funding stay at a ramped minimum weight.
